name: Verve AI – Inventory Forecasting for WooCommerce
author: verveai

sections.description:
Verve AI is an inventory forecasting plugin for WooCommerce that helps store owners make smarter purchasing decisions using AI-driven demand forecasting.

Instead of relying on spreadsheets or gut feel, Verve AI analyzes your historical sales data to generate forward-looking demand forecasts and reorder suggestions — factoring in lead times and recent sales trends.

This plugin acts as the secure connector between your WooCommerce store and the Verve AI forecasting platform.

Ideal for:
* WooCommerce merchants managing physical inventory
* Store owners struggling with stockouts or excess stock
* Businesses that want data-driven reorder planning without complex ERP systems

Key Features:

  • AI-Powered Demand Forecasting
    Predict future product demand using historical WooCommerce order data.

  • Lead Time-Aware Reorder Planning
    Account for supplier lead times when calculating when to reorder.

  • Purchase Order Management
    Generate and manage purchase orders based on forecasted demand.

  • Reorder Suggestions & Alerts
    Identify when inventory levels are projected to fall below demand.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect your WooCommerce store to Verve AI
  3. Create your Verve AI account
  4. Sync products and orders securely
  5. View forecasts and manage purchase orders in the Verve AI dashboard

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • An active Verve AI account

External Services

This plugin connects to the Verve AI external service to provide inventory forecasting and purchase order functionality.

Service URL:
https://app2.getverveai.com

The plugin cannot function without this external service.

Why External Processing Is Required

Inventory forecasting requires analyzing historical sales patterns, trends, and seasonality. This processing is performed on Verve AI’s secure servers to ensure accuracy and performance without impacting your WordPress site.

Data Transmitted to Verve AI

The following store data may be transmitted securely:

  • Store domain and basic store settings (currency, timezone)
  • Product data (titles, SKUs, prices, inventory levels)
  • Historical order data (order dates, quantities, line items)

No customer personal data (such as customer names, emails, addresses, payment details, or passwords) is transmitted or stored.

When Data Is Transmitted

  • During initial store connection (OAuth authentication)
  • During product and order synchronization (manual or automated)
  • When generating forecasts or accessing the dashboard

Data Retention

Store data is retained while your Verve AI account is active.
If you disconnect your store or delete your account, all associated data is permanently deleted within 30 days.

Service Policies

  • Terms of Service: https://app2.getverveai.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://app2.getverveai.com/privacy-policy

User Consent

By connecting your WooCommerce store to Verve AI, you consent to the data transmission described above.
You may revoke consent at any time by disconnecting the plugin from the WordPress admin.
sections.installation:
1. Add the Verve AI plugin from the WordPress store
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Navigate to Verve AI in the WordPress admin sidebar
  4. Click Connect to Verve AI and follow the setup steps
sections.faq:
Do I need a Verve AI account?

Yes. The plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the Verve AI forecasting platform.
Account details and pricing are available at https://getverveai.com.

How does the forecasting work?

Verve AI analyzes your WooCommerce order history using an AI forecasting model that emphasizes recent sales while incorporating longer-term historical trends.

Does Verve AI access customer personal data?

No. Verve AI only processes aggregated order and product data for forecasting purposes.
Customer personal information is not transmitted or stored.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication is encrypted, and authentication is handled using secure OAuth tokens.
WooCommerce admin credentials are never stored.

Can I disconnect my store?

Yes. You can disconnect at any time from the plugin settings page.
